title: key_rotate.rs: signature over rotation article produced but not stored — article sent unsigned
description: key_rotate.rs cmd_key_rotate() line 129: let _signature = old_signing_key.sign(&article_bytes); The signature is computed but discarded (prefixed _). The article_bytes returned to the caller has no X-Stoa-Sig header or any other signature attachment. A rotation announcement without a signature cannot be verified by receiving peers and is indistinguishable from a forged rotation. The comment says 'signing happens in the caller' but the only callers (main.rs) send the article bytes directly without adding a signature. The signature must be appended to the article before it is published.
